This cluster combines strong cytotoxic lymphocyte markers (GZMA, PRF1, NKG7 — hallmarks of NK cells/cytotoxic T cells) with a prominent proliferation/cell-cycle signature (STMN1, HMGB2, TUBA1B, DEK, HMGN2, PTMA, NUCKS1). This pattern is characteristic of proliferating cytotoxic lymphocytes (a mix of actively dividing NK/cytotoxic T cells), often seen as a distinct "proliferating NK/T" cluster in PBMC scRNA-seq data.
